notes: ICEoxford publishes no outer dimensions for the DRY ICE 3K INV (product page, brochure, 3K&10K overview page all checked; GoPhotonics has no INV listing). outer.height is a 0 sentinel and outer.width_or_diameter is the 134 mm sample-space bore, NOT the vacuum can - renderer must treat both as unknown. Architecture from sources: inverted GM cold head (cold stages point UP), 50K stage carrying the radiation shield, sample platform above it, removable top can OVC, 'Up to 8 custom wiring ports' on the top plate, 3D-printed low-vibration frame with edge-welded bellows holding the cold head. Catalog family says GM; ICEoxford pages do not name the cooler type or vendor. This configuration: DC/RF wiring kit installed (sample space 81 mm), no windows fitted (optical access optional), Magnetic Field N/A. Other spec: 50 mW @ 3 K, 100 mW @ 3.25 K; cooldown 3 h to 4 K, 4 h to 3 K; stability +/-10 mK at/below 4 K; vibration at sample +/-1.3 um; Lakeshore 335 controller. The coax entry count=0 means 'count not published', not 'no coax'.
